relevance_note: Single-patient case report of a boy with Danon disease and a LAMP2 frameshift: "the patient was hemizygous for a frameshift mutation in the LAMP2 gene, confirming the diagnosis of Danon disease".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; no tables. JSON assembled with a short Python script from values chosen by reading. One in-scope person (label 'patient', rule 5). The variant is printed twice: 'L141VfsX9' (Case Presentation) and 'p.Leu141ValfsX9' (Discussion); the HGVS-style protein form was used as variant_original_string, no cDNA or transcript printed; '(Xq24)' is a cytoband, not coordinates, so genomic field null. Out of scope (group level only, no individual rows): the two unrelated 16-year-old boys of ref 1 (described jointly), the seven patients of Maron et al. (ref 3, group statistics), and the 75- and 24-subject cohorts of ref 9. Age at diagnosis not stated: presentation at 15 years, SVT 'Two years later', genetic diagnosis after that, so no number is printed. Age at last evaluation not stated (two years after diagnosis). Vital status 'alive' inferred from 'continued to be symptomatic' two years after diagnosis. Normal skeletal muscle strength and tone recorded as excluded muscle weakness and abnormal muscle tone (D-27), and as excluded proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy) on the checklist. 'mild cognitive delay' recorded under cognitive impairment; developmental delay left not reported. LVOT obstruction: 'no significant' obstruction recorded as excluded, although a severe intracavitary gradient (85 mm Hg) is reported. Discussion sentence 'including our case, the central nervous and skeletal myopathic symptoms are usually mild or clinically silent' is ambiguous for this person and was not used. No family history of cardiomyopathies, arrhythmias or sudden death is stated, but no relatives are described individually and no parental testing is reported. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: no earlier report of this patient is mentioned (a future separate publication on the variant is announced). No contradictions found.

span: the patient was started on an oral β-blocker and received an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator
which was aborted via antitachycardia pacing
The patient then underwent radiofrequency ablation of two accessory pathways within the tricuspid valve annulus.
Antiarrhythmic agents were being titrated with the hope of controlling symptoms.
The patient had not yet been considered for a heart transplantation.

disease_label_as_stated.span: confirming the diagnosis of Danon disease

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: genetic testing (hemizygous LAMP2 frameshift) after clinical suspicion from WPW with massive LVH and PET/CT; presumptive sarcomeric HCM before; no myocardial biopsy
span: an association between WPW and massive LVH introduced a suspicion for Danon syndrome
Subsequent genetic testing revealed that the patient was hemizygous for a frameshift mutation in the LAMP2 gene, confirming the diagnosis of Danon disease.
The presumptive diagnosis was sarcomeric HCM.
A myocardial biopsy was not performed.
